tutorial.foundation: There are eight foundations, two per suit. They **start empty**: the first four build from A and the other four from 2, in the same suit by skipping one rank and wrapping around (A-3-5-...-K-2-4-...-Q; 2-4-6-...-Q-A-3-...-K). All eight need 13 cards (104 total) to win.
tutorial.tableau: Sixteen tableau spaces are dealt one card each, and four reserve piles are dealt three cards each (16 cards on the tableau and 12 in reserve; the remaining 76 cards are the stock). Each tableau space holds **one card and cards cannot be stacked**; cards can be sent to foundations. From reserve, **only the top card** is available, and **an emptied pile is never refilled**.
tutorial.emptyPile: When a tableau space empties, it can be refilled **only from the stock or the waste**. A tableau card can never move into an empty space, so an empty space is not a tool for rearranging the board -- it is an outlet for the stock. Empty reserve piles are never refilled.
tutorial.stock: Turn the stock one card at a time onto the waste. **There is no redeal -- one pass only.** When a pile is empty you can place straight from the stock without spending a turn on the waste.
tutorial.controls: Draw, hint, undo, auto-complete, and the other controls.
